sources.title: Internet Archive: Using The Wayback Machine
relevant_sections: Where is the rest of the archived site?
Why are some sites harder to archive than others?
sources.paraphrase: Missing archived images commonly mean the image was not saved. JavaScript-generated links lacking a literal complete target URL are harder to archive.
sources.application: Dynamic addshots construction versus literal nested guide preview URLs is a plausible explanation of the observed pattern, not proof of the exact historical crawl behavior.

sources.title: Internet Archive: CDX Server API
sources.paraphrase: Prefix queries describe URL and time coverage in a capture index. Limits and continuation keys must be accounted for. An index result is not a verified image response.
